normal_signature: First-person perspective from inside a vehicle looking forward
Vehicle dashboard or hood visible in the immediate foreground
Road surface extending into the distance with lane markings
Surrounding environment includes parked or moving vehicles
Street infrastructure such as trees, buildings, or signs visible
hypothesized_anomaly_modes: Camera obstruction or failure resulting in a completely black, white, or static-filled image
Perspective shift where the camera is not mounted on a vehicle (e.g., aerial view, pedestrian view)
Absence of a drivable road surface (e.g., view of a wall, sky, or interior room)
Severe motion blur or distortion indicating sensor malfunction rather than vehicle speed
rules: if the image shows a dashboard, hood, or windshield wipers in the foreground then lean normal
if the image shows a road surface extending away from the camera then lean normal
if the image is completely black, white, or filled with digital noise then lean anomaly
if the image shows a view from a pedestrian height or aerial view without vehicle parts then lean anomaly
if the image shows a static indoor scene or a solid wall without a road then lean anomaly
